# step input

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stepInput`](gmeow-stepInput.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stepInput>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An entity consumed by a procedure step — a dataset, ingredient, document, tool, or any other resource. Range is [owl:Thing](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing) to admit any input type. Non-functional: a step may have multiple inputs, and competing input claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
